detail: Insert a verify.result step after each tool.call that mutates state; affected tools: db.write, api.post. Add the step immediately after the tool call in the same turn, before any subsequent action.
rationale: Finding F1 (feedback.no-verify-after-mutation): 18 of 24 state-mutating calls had no verification step in the same turn. This is the highest-leverage Feedback gap per the 2x2 diagnostic (feedback column empty).
